slides.texte_overlay:
Things your grandfather
did better than you

1. He wrote letters by hand

A few lines on paper
said more than 50 texts.

2. He fixed things

A broken chair got glue,
not a new chair.

3. He bought one good pair
of shoes and kept them

Polished every Sunday.
They lasted 20 years.

4. He knew his neighbors

By name. By family.
He'd help them move
without being asked.

5. His handshake
was a contract

He said it, he did it.
No reminders needed.

6. He kept learning

The paper every morning.
A book every night.
He always had
something to say.
slides.texte_sophia:
6. He kept learning

I do it my way:
5 minutes a day on the Sophia app.
Always something to say.
